transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. AI. What brings you in today?

Hi. I came in today because, well, I feel like I just can't get my schoolwork and my little accessories shop organized at the same time. It's getting to be too much. My supplies, due dates, receipts, and my assignment notes... they all just end up in these big piles everywhere. And when I try to sit down and deal with it, I honestly just don't know what to do first.
Did you have similar trouble staying organized or finishing schoolwork when you were a child?

Yeah, I did. Actually, my mom still has some of my old notes from my elementary school teachers. They pretty much all say that I was always getting out of my seat, or just... talking before I was even called on. And they'd mention how I was always rushing through group activities, even when I actually understood the work perfectly fine. So, yeah, it's been an issue for a while.
Do you often lose important things like your keys, phone, papers, or school materials?

Not really, no. I mean, like I said, my stuff is definitely in big piles all over the place, but I don't usually lose my phone or my keys. I pretty much always have my phone right in my hand or my pocket. Sometimes I have to dig around for a minute to find a specific receipt for the shop or a school paper, but I usually know it's in one of those piles somewhere. So, no, I wouldn't say I actually lose things.
Do you often avoid social situations because you worry other people will criticize or reject you?

No, I don't think so. I actually really like being around people. I mean, I talk a lot, so social stuff is usually pretty easy for me. I don't really worry about people judging me or anything like that. I just kind of do my own thing.
